plan.notes: Source: official BGSU 2024-2025 Undergraduate Catalog (catoid=20), 'Psychology, B.S.' degree planner (preview_degree_planner.php?catoid=20&poid=7028&print), fetched 2026-09-30. TRANSCRIPTION METHOD: COLLECTOR-ARRANGED 8-semester sequence. BGSU planners are requirement checksheets, not semester plans; semester placement was arranged by the collector following prerequisite chains (PSYC 1010->2700/2900/3700; PSYC 2700->3000-level labs). Caveats: (1) Semester placement is collector-arranged, not from an official BGSU semester plan. (2) Generic slots (BG Perspective, Minor/Cognate, Psychology Category, Psychology Lab, University Elective) are choice:true; specific courses chosen with advisor. (3) The 3 category courses must be from 3 different categories per the catalog. (4) Total 122 hrs = BGSU graduation minimum (verified on this planner); includes 40 hrs at 3000/4000 level per catalog (labs 6 + categories 9 + PSYC elective 3 + minor 12 + electives 12 = 42). (5) BIOL 2040+2050 and MATH 1310 per the B.S. requirements.
